slug: 2026-03-22 Ethiopia opens Africa's first unmanned Smart Police Station

systems.tiers: one unmanned station in Addis Ababa, inaugurated by the Prime Minister: self-service touchscreen kiosks where citizens report crimes, file complaints, pay fines and request documents around the clock, with officers on video call; one on-site manager; submitted cases are assigned to police personnel

note: No fact: the only system described is a self-service channel for the public, classed public; the document says submitted cases are assigned to police personnel but describes no station system in which officers record them.
